## Description
Please include a summary of the change and which issue is fixed.

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Security update

## Security Impact (Required for all PRs)
Describe how this PR affects the security posture of the project:
*   [ ] Does this PR introduce new dependencies? If yes, have they been audited?
*   [ ] Does this PR change authentication, authorization, or cryptography?
*   [ ] Does this PR handle sensitive user data (passwords, tokens, device secrets)?
*   [ ] Are there any new network requests or external bridges created?

## Testing
- [ ] I have tested these changes locally.
- [ ] All CI checks pass.
- [ ] Security regressions are covered (re-auth, encryption validation).
